## LANE 3 - Receipt Check & Document Requests
Weekdays 9:00 and 14:00. Expenses at or above the receipt threshold ($100) are matched to files in the Drive receipts folder (file name must contain QB-<id>). Missing -> Jev drafts a request -> a person approves in Airtable (Status = Approved to Send) -> Gmail sends -> follow-up date set. File appears later -> Received (person sets Verified). No receipt by follow-up date -> Escalated + email to the team. TEST MODE sends all emails to the test recipient.

parameters.content:
## LANE 5 - Overdue Invoice Follow-up
Weekdays 9:30. Open QuickBooks invoices past due (after a 3-day grace period, balance at least $25) are tracked in Airtable (Invoice Follow-ups). Jev drafts a reminder -> a person approves (Status = Approved to Send) -> Gmail sends -> next check in 7 days. Still unpaid after 2 reminders, or 60+ days overdue -> Escalated for a person (no automatic email). Invoice no longer open in QuickBooks -> Paid / Closed. Partial payments are noted. On Hold / Cancelled are left alone. TEST MODE sends all emails to the test recipient.

parameters.content:
## LANE 6 - Weekly Report
Mondays 7:45. Reads the Airtable tables only (no QuickBooks calls) and builds the week's figures: expenses, exceptions, receipts, overdue invoices, system errors, and what needs a person. Jev writes a short plain-language summary from those figures only. HTML email to the team + a copy of the figures in the Audit Log. If Jev is unavailable, the report is still sent without the summary.
